answer: Price one clone end to end: registration, one task, one escrow, one bond. Escrow holds until finality. Idle standing bleeds 4 percent per epoch. Edge case: 50 clones kept warm cost 50 escrows forever. Edge case: a clone that submits once still decays while it waits. A lotus of 50 reads like a mirror of 50 real agents for one epoch, then the zephyr of decay separates the ledgers.
